description: One Unsloth install harness with --method {lora:r8,lora:r64,lora:r256,fwft}: FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained(full_finetuning=(method=='fwft')) else get_peft_model(r=rank). Emits standard HF ckpt served by scimt.eval.sample (vLLM). Same path covers every grid cell AND the FT stressors (chain a 2nd run from a saved ckpt), so the method contrast is stack-clean. EXIT: each method trains 1 cell + evals end-to-end on Qwen3-14B.
title: P0-b: one Unsloth install harness with --method (lora:r8/r64/r256, fwft)
